name: Salesforce
description: Monitor Salesforce user access and contact data management for CRM compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. In Salesforce: Setup → App Manager → New Connected App.
2. Enable OAuth Settings.
3. Set the Callback URL to: https://api.trycomp.ai/v1/integrations/oauth/callback
4. Add OAuth scopes: Access the identity URL service (id), Manage user data via APIs (api), Perform requests at any time (refresh_token, offline_access).
5. Save the Connected App. Copy the Consumer Key (Client ID) and Consumer Secret.
6. Wait a few minutes for the Connected App to propagate, then click Connect in Comp AI and sign in to your Salesforce org.

Notes:
 - This integration currently supports Salesforce Production orgs (login.salesforce.com). Sandbox (test.salesforce.com) is not yet supported.
 - The Salesforce instance URL is discovered automatically after connection — no manual entry needed.
